India-Pakistan Water Dispute Takes a Turn

The India-Pakistan water dispute has taken a new turn with Pakistan expressing its intention to continue the project despite any improvement in relations. The project, which aims to generate 5500 megawatts of electricity, is seen as a key aspect of the agreement. However, the future of the deal remains uncertain due to ongoing tensions between the two countries.
